== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|An [[Endross]] Gate serves as a [[portal]] connecting the current world to the [[Territory]] of [[Endross]], a brutal desert wasteland characterized by extreme thunderstorms and dangerous jungles filled with predators. These [[Gates]] manifest as swirling, hungry thunderstorms that can appear in a [[Traveler]]'s palm or hang in midair. A unique property of these [[Gates]] is that they increase in size and potency the longer they remain open, providing the user with more power. However, this growth carries significant risk; if a [[Traveler]] loses control, the Gate can become unstable and explode, consuming the user. While [[Travelers]] use these openings to access power or transport creatures and people, specialized entities known as gatecrawlers can force a closed Gate back open shortly after it shuts, allowing them to follow [[Travelers]] into their home [[Territory]].}}
